sceneCreate.content1: Mist rolled over the stone steps at the summit of Qingyun Mountain. Lin Yi stood at the cliff edge and looked into the valley below.
sceneCreate.content2: The edges of the jade were worn smooth, but the crack on its back looked fresh. Lin Yi reached for it. Before his fingers touched it, Su Wan tightened her grip.

ai.input: Read the project files, then continue this chapter
ai.response: I have loaded the current chapter and related project files.
ai.desc: The current file, outline, character sheets, and world notes are available in this conversation.

sceneSuggest.content1: Mist rolled over the stone steps at the summit of Qingyun Mountain. Lin Yi stood at the cliff edge and looked into the valley below.
sceneSuggest.content2: Three years earlier, the awakening ceremony had declared his meridians broken. He had not entered the inner court since.
sceneSuggest.content3: Footsteps sounded behind him. Su Wan stepped through the mist and set a jade token bearing the old Lin crest before him.

ai.input: Continue with Su Wan bringing a new clue
ai.response: I will continue from the current chapter and character context.
ai.desc: The continuation is written directly to the current chapter.

sceneEdit.originalText: Su Wan walked out of the mist and handed the jade token to Lin Yi.
sceneEdit.suggestionText: Su Wan stepped through the mist and set a jade token bearing the old Lin crest before him.

ai.input: Make Su Wan’s entrance more specific
ai.response: I rewrote the paragraph using the current chapter.
ai.desc: Accept to save a new version, or return to the version before this edit.
